entries.claim: This separate Postcommunion prints the accented conclusion with no comma after Christum and the colon and uppercase Qui after tuum, ending with Deus. locator.section: Top conclusion and response before the Nativity preface dialogue; Per omnia saecula saeculorum. R. Amen.

entries.claim: The top chant line prints Per omnia saecula saeculorum and the response Amen. The composite joins musical syllable divisions and omits the response marker. Only these five words are used; the Nativity preface dialogue and body are excluded.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a; Father-addressed oration conclusion

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
